integrity: Symbolic cancellation and direct finite trigonometric perturbation checks in checks/cyclic_cubic_check.py supplement the self-contained analytic proof. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of independently uniform unit-circle vertices; near-maximal-perimeter limit, not a uniform-in-side-count or general-boundary theorem. Gap-vector convergence is in total variation and residual convergence is joint weak convergence. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp cubic area–perimeter cancellation and a conditional shape law for cyclic polygons
